<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 12"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Defensive Dismissal](/Feats.aspx?ID=5404) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Druid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=583" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 56

**Trigger**
A creature you’re aware of critically succeeds on a \Strike against you.

**Requirements**
You’re under a [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=670) effect that you can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311).

</column>

---

You change your form as a means of evading a potentially fatal blow. You Dismiss the polymorph effect you're under, and the result of the triggering Strike becomes a success instead of a critical success. If you would no longer fit in your space as a result of returning to your normal form, this action fails and you don't Dismiss the polymorph effect.
